steps.text: Enter the Goblin Cave next to the Fishing Guild. A plain of mud sphere will teleport you inside the cave.
Drink the goblin potion.
Confirm to become a goblin. Your selection doesn't matter.
Go down the stairs to the goblin temple. WARNING: If you equip your items too early, you will turn back to human!
Enter the door to the crypt. Don't equip your items yet!
Equip your ring and ghostspeak item and talk to the ghost in the crypt.
Enter the Goblin Cave next to the Fishing Guild. A plain of mud sphere will teleport you inside the cave.
Go down the stairs to the goblin temple.
Enter the door to the crypt.
Unequip all weapons and armour (the ring of visibility and ghostspeak amulet can stay on but you MUST unequip Morytania legs). Say Snothead's name at the south-west grave.
Unequip all weapons and armour (the ring of visibility and ghostspeak amulet can stay on but you MUST unequip Morytania legs). Say Snailfeet's name at the south-east grave.
Unequip all weapons and armour (the ring of visibility and ghostspeak amulet can stay on but you MUST unequip Morytania legs). Say Mosschin's name at the north-west grave.
Unequip all weapons and armour (the ring of visibility and ghostspeak amulet can stay on but you MUST unequip Morytania legs). Say Redeyes's name at the north-east grave.
Unequip all weapons and armour (the ring of visibility and ghostspeak amulet can stay on but you MUST unequip Morytania legs). Say Strongbones's name at the north grave.
Defeat Snothead WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using melee.
Defeat Snailfeet WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using melee and range.
Defeat Mosschin WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using melee and magic.
Defeat Redeyes WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using melee and magic, and lowers your attack, strength, and defence.
Defeat Strongbones WITHOUT using weapons, armour, or magic. He attacks using all 3 combat styles, lowers your attack, strength and defence. Ignore the level 29 Skoblins he spawns.
Pick up Snothead's bone from the ground.
Pick up Snailfeet's bone from the ground.
Pick up Mosschin's bone from the ground.
Pick up Redeyes's bone from the ground.
Pick up Strongbones's bone from the ground.
Take all five bones to Yu'Biusk. You must get there via fairy ring BLQ.
Bury Snothead's bone.
Bury Snailfeet's bone.
Bury Mosschin's bone.
Bury Redeyes' bone.
Bury Strongbones' bone.
